main_text.head: SENECA
Lib. III. de Irâ, cap. XLIII.
main_text.p: Dum inter homines fumus, colamus Humanitatem: non timori cuiquam, non periculo fimus: detrimenta, injurias, convitia, vellicationes contemnamus, & magno animo brevia feramus incommoda.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is faint and ignored. The heading "SENECA" is in spaced capitals with the initial S larger. Possible printing spacing irregularities in the paragraph ("fumus, colamus", "Humanitatem:") are left as printed.
